_comment: The one place the deployed host is written down. tools/build-sitemap.mjs and tools/inject-meta.mjs both read it, so moving to a custom domain is this file plus re-running them. Nothing else in the repo should contain an absolute URL to the site.

socialCard._comment: Served from the site root, so the file itself lives in public/. Width and height are NOT written here on purpose -- tools/inject-meta.mjs reads them out of the PNG, so the tags can never disagree with the file.
socialCard.alt: The Studio 22 wordmark, gold on black.
